import unittest
from unittest.mock import patch, MagicMock
from your_gui_module import YourGUIClass

class TestYourGUI(unittest.TestCase):

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_patient_pressure')
    def test_gui_display_patient_pressure(self, mock_get_patient_pressure):
        # Precondition
        mock_get_patient_pressure.return_value = 120  # as specified
        gui = YourGUIClass()

        # Test steps
        gui.update_patient_pressure()

        # Expected result
        mock_get_patient_pressure.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(gui.patient_pressure_display, 120)

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_volume')
    def test_gui_graph_refresh_rate(self, mock_get_volume):
        # Precondition
        mock_get_volume.return_value = 100  # as specified
        gui = YourGUIClass()

        # Test steps
        for _ in range(100):  # 5 seconds * 20 Hz
            gui.update_volume_graph()

        # Expected result
        mock_get_volume.assert_called_with(100)
        self.assertEqual(len(gui.volume_graph_data), 100)

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_volume')
    def test_gui_graph_duration(self, mock_get_volume):
        # Precondition
        mock_get_volume.return_value = 100  # as specified
        gui = YourGUIClass()

        # Test steps
        for _ in range(600):  # 30 seconds * 20 Hz
            gui.update_volume_graph()

        # Expected result
        mock_get_volume.assert_called_with(100)
        self.assertEqual(len(gui.volume_graph_data), 600)

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_inspiratory_tidal_volume')
    def test_gui_display_inspiratory_tidal_volume(self, mock_get_inspiratory_tidal_volume):
        # Precondition
        mock_get_inspiratory_tidal_volume.return_value = 500  # as specified
        gui = YourGUIClass()

        # Test steps
        gui.update_inspiratory_tidal_volume()

        # Expected result
        mock_get_inspiratory_tidal_volume.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(gui.tidal_volume_display, 500)

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_ratio')
    def test_gui_display_ratio(self, mock_get_ratio):
        # Precondition
        mock_get_ratio.return_value = 15  # as specified
        gui = YourGUIClass()

        # Test steps
        gui.update_ratio()

        # Expected result
        mock_get_ratio.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(gui.ratio_display, 15)

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_peep')
    def test_gui_display_peep(self, mock_get_peep):
        # Precondition
        mock_get_peep.return_value = 10  # as specified
        gui = YourGUIClass()

        # Test steps
        gui.update_peep()

        # Expected result
        mock_get_peep.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(gui.peep_display, 10)

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_volume')
    def test_gui_display_volume_graph(self, mock_get_volume):
        # Precondition
        mock_get_volume.return_value = 100  # as specified
        gui = YourGUIClass()

        # Test steps
        gui.update_volume_graph()

        # Expected result
        mock_get_volume.assert_called_once()
        self.assertEqual(len(gui.volume_graph_data), 1)

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_flow_rate')
    def test_gui_display_flow_rate_graph(self, mock_get_flow_rate):
        # Precondition
        mock_get_flow_rate.return_value = 2  # as specified
        gui = YourGUIClass()

        # Test steps
        for _ in range(100):  # 5 seconds * 20 Hz
            gui.update_flow_rate_graph()

        # Expected result
        mock_get_flow_rate.assert_called_with(2)
        self.assertEqual(len(gui.flow_rate_graph_data), 100)

    @patch('your_gui_module.YourGUIClass.get_flow_rate')
    def test_gui_display_flow_rate_graph_refresh_rate(self, mock_get_flow_rate):
        # Precondition
        mock_get_flow_rate.return_value = 2  # as specified
        gui = YourGUIClass()

        # Test steps
        for _ in range(600):  # 30 seconds * 20 Hz
            gui.update_flow_rate_graph()

        # Expected result
        mock_get_flow_rate.assert_called_with(2)
        self.assertEqual(len(gui.flow_rate_graph_data), 600)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
